description: This PHP source file defines a trait named EntityManagerHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides helper methods for managing database entities with Doctrine ORM, including fetching repositories, persisting, removing entities, creating query builders, pagination, and transaction controls.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns a repository for the specified entity class using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists a given entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a given entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance for the specified entity with alias and optional index by.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a custom Paginator object for paginated results.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a custom QueryBuilderWrapper object.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Executes a QueryBuilder to fetch a single entity at the specified offset.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Provides a reference to an entity by class name and ID without fully loading it.

methods.name: rollBackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.
